name: cdp5-agents
description: CDP5 agents for the engineering loop: nine judgment and counter-roles, three implementation workers, the orchestrate skill for the main session and cdp5-doctor for the host check. Shared worker contract via hooks (acknowledgement, hedged-claim check, usage log), an allowlist shell guard with human-confirmed run grants, a SessionStart bootstrap, the scripts worktree-setup and grant-run, and an eval suite.
